event.name: NEARCON 2026
event.theme: Intelligence, Privacy, and the Open Web

venue.name: Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture
venue.accessibility: We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive experience for all attendees.

registration.confirmation: You will receive a confirmation when registered.
registration.includes: Access to all conference sessions and events.
registration.badgePickup: Badge pickup information will be provided closer to the event date.

dressCode.description: No formal dress code required. NEARCON is a conference and cultural gathering — wear what makes you comfortable.
dressCode.sideEvents: Some side events may have different dress expectations.

photography.personal: Personal photography is welcome in public areas.
photography.professional: Professional video and livestreaming require written approval from the NEARCON Media Team.
photography.release: By registering for NEARCON, you agree that photographs and video taken at the event may be used by NEAR Foundation.

privacy.badgeInfo: Your basic registration information (name, company, email) may be encoded in your badge.
privacy.sponsorScanning: By allowing a sponsor to scan your badge, you consent to sharing this information with them.

policies.bags: All bags are subject to security screening upon entry to Fort Mason Center and other official venues. Please allow extra time for security screening.

logistics.wifi: Complimentary WiFi will be available to all registered attendees at Fort Mason Center.
logistics.security: Venue security and staff will be present at all times. All attendees must have a valid badge to access event areas.
logistics.safety: Safety is a top priority at NEARCON.

press.credentials: Apply for press credentials through the press form on nearcon.org.
press.approval: All applications are reviewed and approved by the NEARCON Media Team.

agenda.note: Speaker information and agenda details will be announced closer to the event. Check nearcon.org for the latest updates.
